confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregated Mombasa cost-of-living and price-comparison figures, converted at about 130 KES per USD, and they conflict across sources, so treat them as bounded estimates. Cappuccino and cocktail figures are the least certain. Wine and beer are judged from a few venue-level guide prices, not a broad survey. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Kenya's coastal market; no accommodation searches were run and no live listings were checked. The FX observation is the most recent RBA USD/AUD value I could confirm from a cached RBA snapshot in search results (20 March 2026). I did not confirm it is the latest observation as of 2026-11-19, so it may be stale.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable foreign city was used. Food and drink anchors are based on Mombasa-specific aggregated figures (Numbeo-derived and cost-of-living site averages, plus a few Mombasa and Nyali venue menus, which may include Diani-area or tourist-oriented pricing). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for Mombasa's mixed city and beach-resort hotel market.
